identity.name: QUEUE
identity.description: A minimalist, high-contrast queue management system that reduces anxiety through clarity and calm aesthetics.

headings.usage: All headings, and critically, for the Queue Numbers. The digits must be beautiful.

primary.name: Electric Indigo
primary.usage: Primary actions (Join Queue, Login), Active States.

urgent.name: Signal Orange
urgent.usage: Your Turn notification, 'Call Next' button (high visibility).

rules: Use 'Signal Orange' ONLY for the 'Your Turn' state or 'Call Next' action.
Dashboard background must be 'slate-50' (#F8FAFC) to differentiate from white cards.

spacing.base: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards.

client_mobile.focus: The Number is the Hero. It should occupy 40% of the screen height.
client_mobile.alignment: Center-aligned for the number, Left-aligned for details.

visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise overlay on the dashboard background (opacity 0.02).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly. Only for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80).

images.description: Minimalist coffee shop interior with sunlight. Use for 'For Establishments' section.
White textured surface. Use as a subtle background for the login/signup pages.
Abstract blue curves. Use for the 'Client View' waiting screen background (low opacity).

media.icons: lucide-react (default). Use thin strokes (stroke-width={1.5}) for elegance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is slate-900 on white. Slate-500 for secondary text.
accessibility.screen_readers: All status updates (Your turn!) must use aria-live='polite'.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text.
DO NOT use 'Inter' for headings. Use 'Manrope'.
DO NOT center everything. Use asymmetry for interest.
Padding is luxury. Use p-8 where you'd normally use p-4.
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-performance, minimalist queue app. Focus on the 'Number' display—it is the core UI element. It should be large, legible, and animate smoothly when changing. The dashboard should feel like a cockpit: dense but organized. Use the provided image URLs for the landing page and auth screens.
